perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.description: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

enhanced.name: Heal Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies. You have additional time to perform the reload.

perks.name: Air Trigger
perks.description: Increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are increased but target acquisition is decreased.

enhanced.name: Air Trigger
enhanced.description: Greatly increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are further increased but target acquisition is decreased.

perks.name: Blast Distributor
perks.description: Dealing splash damage grants a bonus to Grenade stat.

enhanced.name: Blast Distributor
enhanced.description: Dealing splash damage grants an improved bonus to Grenade stat.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

enhanced.name: Perpetual Motion
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion for a short duration.

perks.name: Slideways
perks.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability.

enhanced.name: Slideways
enhanced.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability greatly.

perks.name: Light Touch
perks.description: This weapon gains reload speed, handling, and aim down sight speed when you are amplified, radiant, or have Devour.

enhanced.name: Light Touch
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased reload speed, handling, and aim down sight speed when you are amplified, radiant, or have Devour.

perks.name: Sleight of Hand
perks.description: Final blows with weapons or abilities while this weapon is stowed increase its handling, stability, and reload speed for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Sleight of Hand
enhanced.description: Final blows with weapons or abilities while this weapon is stowed increase its handling, stability, and reload speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: Paracausal Affinity
perks.description: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for a short period of time. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.

enhanced.name: Paracausal Affinity
enhanced.description: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for an improved duration. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

enhanced.name: Aggregate Charge
enhanced.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target. Damage bonus is increased.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.description:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

enhanced.name: Incandescent
enhanced.description:
Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

enhanced.name: Desperate Measures
enhanced.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage for an improved duration. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

enhanced.name: Burning Ambition
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage more quickly scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Desperado
perks.description: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire.

enhanced.name: Desperado
enhanced.description: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire for an improved duration.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

enhanced.name: Sword Logic
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.
